Users.title: Users
Users.description: Accounts that can log in to this UI. New passwords are checked against the password rules while you type.
Users.noRules: Keycloak has no password rules set.
Users.name: Name
Users.keycloakForbidden: Keycloak doesn't allow admins to manage users yet. One-time setup in the Keycloak console (realm citrineos): Clients -> citrineos-ui -> Roles -> admin -> Associated roles -> assign the realm-management roles view-users, manage-users and view-realm. Then log out and back in.
Users.dialogDescription: The new password works from the next login.
Users.notCompliant: This password doesn't meet the rules marked in red. Keycloak would reject it, so it can't be saved.
